plan.summary_tr:
Altı projenin hepsi incelendi. Rebound ve Premiere MCP raporları girdide kesik geldi, bu yüzden bu iki depoya klonlarından doğrudan baktım (yalnız okudum, hiçbir şey çalıştırmadım).

Lisanslar:
- OpenCurve'ün lisansı yok, yani tüm hakları saklı. Ondan yalnız fikir alınabilir, temiz oda yöntemiyle yazılacak; tek satır kod alınmayacak.
- Rebound (MIT) ve Raunen (MIT): kod uyarlanabilir. Şartı, köke yeni bir THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md dosyası ve her dosyaya başlık satırı eklenmesi.
- Animated Captions, Premiere TR ve Premiere MCP de MIT, ama değerli kısımları fikir düzeyinde. Bunlardan kod alınmıyor. Animated Captions'ın MOGRT/AEP, font ve ffmpeg dosyaları da hiç alınmayacak.

Plan 22 adım, toplam yaklaşık 48 iş günü. Temel işler önce geliyor, sıralama değer/emek oranına göre:

1) Altyazı temeli (1–5. adımlar, ~11 gün):
- Her yerel transkriptte -ojf ile ölçülmüş kelime zamanları. Yan bulgu: yerel motorda güven skoru şu an hep boş geliyor, kalite uyarıları hiç çalışmıyor; bu adım bunu da düzeltiyor.
- [Müzik] / [BLANK_AUDIO] gibi etiketleri ayıklayan filtre ve sessiz ses uyarısı.
- Transkripsiyon sürerken satırların canlı akması, İptal düğmesi ve kalan süre.
- Okunabilir satır düzeni: 2×42, kısa parçaları birleştirme, düzenlemede kelime zamanlarının korunması.
- Hızlı / En doğru çözme seçimi, DTW ile hassas kelime zamanlaması ve çevrimdışı İngilizce çeviri.

2) Kesim (6–8, ~6,5 gün):
- Sürgü sürüklendikçe anında güncellenen sessizlik haritası, Min. konuşma ayarı ve Otomatik eşik.
- Sekans ve In/Out kapsamında kesim, müzik katmanını koruma seçeneği.
- Kesimden sonra altyazının yeni kurguya uyarlanması.

3) Eğri (9–15, ~13 gün):
- Rebound'un MIT easing motoru üzerine yeni bir 'Eğri' sekmesi. Kullanıcı kendi anahtar karelerine bezier, yay ya da zıplama yumuşatması uygulayabilecek; canlı önizleme ve kayıt tabanlı geri alma olacak.
- Aynı eğriler Geçişler, Zoom ve Hareket araçlarına da gelecek.
- Biten Hız Rampası'na 'Özel eğri' editörü eklenecek.
- Varışta yaylanma ve SFC1 paylaşım kodları.
- Tek klipte uygulama ücretsiz, çünkü OpenCurve ücretsiz bir rakip; birden çok klibe toplu uygulama Pro.

4) Stil ve altyapı (16–22, ~18 gün):
- Animasyon karıştırıcı; gölge, kutu ve italik ayarları; serbest X/Y konum.
- Yeni fontlar.
- Kurumsal ağ desteği ve çevrimdışı model içe aktarma.
- Ctrl+K ile araç arama.
- Render gerektirmeyen, Premiere'e özgü kelime vurgulu MOGRT. Bunun için AE şablonunu senin hazırlaman gerekiyor.
- En sonda MCP köprüsü.

MCP kararı: v4 yol haritasında ertelenmişti. Eklenmesini istediğin için dar ve güvenli bir sürüm planladım:
- Varsayılan olarak kapalı, 'Deneysel' etiketli.
- Yalnız 127.0.0.1'de çalışır; rastgele port ve 256 bit jeton kullanır.
- Host/Origin denetimiyle tarayıcıdan gelen istekleri reddeder.
- Keyfi ExtendScript çalıştırmaz; yalnız Suflo'nun kendi eylemleri var: altyazı, kopya sekansta sessizlik kesimi, marker, zoom, eğri, hız rampası.
- Yıkıcı eylemler için panelde onay istenir.
- Pro kapıları ve deneme hakları aynen geçerli.
Projenin 170 ham aracı, ElevenLabs entegrasyonu ve kimlik doğrulamasız WebSocket'i alınmadı.

Premiere'de denenmesi gerekenler:
- Anahtar kare enterpolasyon değeri (yeni kfInterp yoklaması).
- MOGRT süresi uzatılınca zamanın esneyip esnemediği.
- DTW'nin nicemlenmiş modellerde çalışıp çalışmadığı.
- Hızlı çözmenin Türkçe doğruluğu. Varsayılan, kıyaslama ölçümünden sonra seçilecek.

build_order.title: Her yerel transkriptte ölçülmüş kelime zamanları (-ojf) / Measured word timings in every local transcript (-ojf)
build_order.source_repos: Raunen (MIT): tokensToWords and splitByWords. whisper.cpp v1.9.1 cli.cpp as a reference for the -ojf token JSON.
build_order.spec:
Why: Suflo passes -oj, and whisper.cpp writes per-token data (text, offsets, p, t_dtw) only with -ojf. Meanwhile js/captions.js yerelCalistir (~line 476) computes confidence from t.tokens / avg_logprob, which never exist with -oj. So local-engine confidence is always undefined, and the caption-quality.js 'Motor bu metinden emin değil' flags never fire. Karaoke (k1/kc) also needs a second '-ml 1 -sow' run.

(1) New pure UMD module js/whisper-words.js (window.SufloWhisperWords and module.exports), ES5 and DOM-free:
- kelimelereAyir(seg): merges sub-word tokens into words. A token whose text starts with a space starts a new word. Skip tokens matching /^\s*(\[_|<\|)/ and empty tokens. start/end come from offsets.from/to (ms to s). Fill untimed tokens by char-weighted interpolation between known neighbours, clamped to the segment. Word p = min of its tokens' p. Trailing punctuation stays on its word.
- segmentleriCoz(json): parses -ojf output (transcription[] with offsets and tokens[]) into [{start, end, text, confidence: mean non-special token p, words: [{text, start, end, p}]}]. It must tolerate builds without tokens (old Homebrew whisper-cli): words [] and confidence undefined.
- kelimeGrupla(words, n, araKir = 0.8): groups words across segment boundaries. Flushes every n words, on a pause longer than araKir, or after [.!?…].
- duzlestir(segs) returns the flat word list.

(2) js/engine.js buildArgs:
- Emit -ojf instead of -oj for transcription runs. Leave the English probe run (~line 590) as it is.
- For wordLevel, stop adding '-ml 1 -sow'. Keep that path only as a fallback when a run returns no tokens.

(3) js/captions.js yerelCalistir:
- Replace the inline mapping with SufloWhisperWords.segmentleriCoz. Segments now carry words, and confidence is defined again.
- Apply the same offsets to words in the stall-recovery 'kalan' pass.

(4) js/caption-text.js segmentleriKur:
- k1/kc build from the flattened seg.words when present, so there is one transcription and one cache entry.
- wN uses kelimeGrupla when words exist; otherwise today's splitWords.
- Keep the guard against 8 or more words stacked at the same time.

(5) js/style-engine.js splitToWords (~lines 120-135): use cue.words when its count equals the cue's token count after stripping *emphasis* markers. Otherwise keep the char-weighted fallback. tests/style-engine-snapshot.json must stay byte-identical when words are absent.

(6) js/transcript-cache.js:
- Persist words, and bump the schema version. Old entries stay valid without words.
- Drop the karaoke-only onbMeta restriction (captions.js ~2041) so line mode and word mode share entries.

(7) Editor:
- A text edit drops that cue's words. Rank 4 adds re-alignment.
- Split, merge and bulk shift carry words by time.
- Undo, redo and draft keep words.

(8) Create THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (see attribution notes):
- Add it to $stageItems in tools/package.ps1.
- Fail tools/verify-release.ps1 if it is missing from the staged ZXP.
- Link it from the README.

build_order.title: Ses etiketi filtresi ve sessiz ses uyarısı / Non-speech tag filter and silent-audio guard
build_order.source_repos: Raunen (MIT): NOISE_PATTERNS / isNoise and the peak-below-0.001 warning
build_order.spec:
(1) js/caption-text.js: add GURULTU patterns and gurultuMu(text). These match only when they are the whole cue:
- [BLANK_AUDIO];
- bracketed or parenthesised tag vocabulary: müzik|music|alkış|applause|gülüşme(ler)?|kahkaha|laughter|sessizlik|silence|gürültü|noise|anlaşılmıyor|inaudible|şarkı|singing|nefes|öksürük|cough, optionally wrapped in ♪;
- cues made only of ♪/♫;
- *tag* only when the inner word is in the tag vocabulary, so Suflo's *emphasis* syntax on real words survives.
cleanSegments() drops matching cues. Mixed cues keep their speech and lose the inline tag. Pure-tag words are dropped from k1/kc/word lists.

(2) Setting 'Ses etiketlerini koru' (Ayarlar › Altyazı, default off) keeps tags for accessibility, normalised to '[Müzik]'-style capitalisation. Do not enable whisper -sns: it also suppresses punctuation-like tokens.

(3) Silent-audio guard in js/captions.js:
- After convertAudio() and before any engine runs (local, or cloud upload, which saves API cost), read the 16 kHz mono WAV in 1 MB chunks with fs.readSync and compute the peak |s|.
- If the peak is below 0.001 (about -60 dBFS), show the inline warning 'Ses neredeyse tamamen sessiz: ses kanalları kapalı ya da sessize alınmış olabilir (Altyazı › Ses kanalları)' with 'Yine de devam et' and 'Vazgeç', and log it with K.log.
- The same guard covers the other transcribeSuflo entry points (Konuşmadan kes, Viral anlar).

build_order.title: Canlı transkripsiyon: akan satırlar, İptal ve kalan süre / Live transcription: streaming rows, cancel and ETA
build_order.source_repos: Premiere TR (MIT): the NDJSON streaming UX idea. Raunen (MIT): AbortController with a taskkill /T /F process-tree kill, and progress smoothing with a realtime factor.
build_order.spec:
(1) js/bridge.js run(cmd, args, opts):
- Add opts.onStdout(chunk), mirroring onStderr. stdout is already utf8, and the full output keeps accumulating.
- Add cancellation: opts.iptal takes a token from the new K.iptalJetonu(), shaped {iptalEdildi, iptal(), dinle(fn)}.
- On cancel, Windows runs execFile('taskkill', ['/pid', String(child.pid), '/T', '/F'], {windowsHide:true}) and macOS runs child.kill('SIGKILL').
- Resolve {code:-2, iptal:true}, clear timers and decrement aktifSurec.

(2) New pure UMD module js/whisper-akis.js (SufloWhisperAkis):
- satirAyristirici({offset}) returns {besle(chunk) → [{start, end, text}], bitir()}. It parses '[hh:mm:ss.mmm --> hh:mm:ss.mmm]  text' lines, which whisper-cli prints and fflushes per segment when -np is not set; Suflo does not set it. It buffers partial lines across chunks, handles CRLF, skips tag cues via CT.gurultuMu, and applies the scope offset. Clip scope uses the same inPoint/clipStart mapping as the final JSON.
- ilerlemeYumusat({toplamSn}) returns {kontrol(pct, simdiMs), tahmin(simdiMs) → {pct, kalanSn, hiz}}. -pp checkpoints arrive about every 30 s of audio. Between checkpoints it extrapolates from the observed rate, never passes the next expected checkpoint, and eases toward 5% before the first one.

(3) js/captions.js yerelCalistir:
- Pass onStdout and render provisional rows: dimmed, read-only, with a 'canlı' badge.
- Status line: '12 satır · %34 · ~1 dk 20 sn kaldı · 3,1× gerçek zaman'.
- The final JSON replaces the provisional rows. Provisional rows never enter the draft, transcript cache or undo history.
- Clear them before the stall-recovery rerun. The 'kalan' pass gets its own offset.
- Disabled on the per-token fallback path (-ml 1). Cloud engines are unchanged and do not stream.

(4) İptal:
- While a job runs, #cap-cancel replaces 'Altyazı oluştur'. The token is passed to convertAudio, yerelCalistir (including reruns) and the batch loop, with checks between steps.
- KS_exportAudio is synchronous ExtendScript, so the button is disabled with a tooltip during that step.
- On cancel: delete the temp WAV and JSON, keep the previous draft, show 'İptal edildi', and never apply partial segments.
- Reuse the token for KEngine model and engine downloads (abort the request, keep the .part file for resume) and for magiccut ffmpeg runs.
build_order.reuse: Clean-room: the patterns are trivial. Suflo parses whisper.cpp's own stdout and does not use Premiere TR's Python NDJSON server.
tests: tests/test-whisper-akis.js: lines split across chunks, several lines in one chunk, CRLF, offsets, timestamps of 1 h or more, Turkish UTF-8 text, skipped tag lines, monotonic smoothing that never passes the next checkpoint, ETA and realtime factor
tests/test-iptal.js: stubbed child_process.spawn with a child that never exits; taskkill args on win32, SIGKILL on darwin, resolve shape {code:-2, iptal:true}, aktifSurec counter, timers cleared
tests/test-arayuz.js: #cap-cancel exists and toggles; provisional rows are excluded from the draft and undo stack

build_order.title: Okunabilir altyazı düzeni: kelimeden satır, 2×42, kısa parça birleştirme, düzenlemede kelime hizalama / Readable caption layout: line mode from word timings, balanced 2-line wrap, fragment merge, word re-alignment on edit
build_order.source_repos: Raunen (MIT): wrapText and shapeSegments. Animated Captions / TranscriptAI: the idea of line building with combined max-chars and max-words limits while keeping per-word timings, plus the lesson of their unaligned words[] bug.
build_order.spec:
Builds on rank 1.

(1) New pure UMD module js/caption-layout.js (SufloCaptionLayout):
- kelimedenSatirlar(words, {maxChars:42, maxLines:1|2, maxWords:0 (off) or 2..12, maxSure:6, minSure:0.8, araKir:0.6}): greedy. It breaks when chars exceed maxChars×maxLines, words exceed maxWords, a pause exceeds araKir, after sentence punctuation [.!?…] (Turkish quotes kept), or when the duration exceeds maxSure. Each cue is {start, end, text, words}.
- dengeliSar(text, maxChars, maxLines): tries 2..maxLines lines with a target of ceil(len/lines) and keeps the result with the smallest longest line. Greedy fallback; never drops words. Share the algorithm with style-engine's balanced \N split (~lines 373-385) so the overlay and the caption track agree. Only replace the style-engine call if its snapshot stays byte-identical.
- kisaBirlestir(cues, {aralik:0.2, maxChars, maxLines, maxSure}): merges neighbours with a gap of aralik or less when the result fits. Never merges across a sentence end. Skipped in word modes.
- karakterleBol(cue, budget): greedy split by characters. Times come from words when present, otherwise from character proportion. Replaces splitLong's even-word split, which can overflow the budget.
- zamanHijyeni(cues, {minSure:0.8, maxSure:7}): extends short cues into free gaps without overlapping and trims long ones, with the same semantics as caption-quality fixTiming.
- kelimeleriHizala(oldWords, newText, cueStart, cueEnd, loc): tokenises, runs LCS on normalised tokens (toLocaleLowerCase('tr' or 'az'), punctuation stripped), keeps matched times, and interpolates unmatched tokens between their neighbours.

(2) js/caption-text.js segmentleriKur(mapped, lenVal, opts):
- New lenVal 'l32' and 'l42' (line mode from words) and 'c42x2' (2 lines × 42).
- opts {maxWords, birlestir, minSure, maxSure}.
- Falls back to today's logic when words are absent.

(3) js/captions.js:
- The Satır uzunluğu menu gets '2 satır × 42 (YouTube/TV)' and a 'Kelime sınırı' number (0 = off).
- Ayarlar › Altyazı gets min/max süre and 'Kısa parçaları birleştir'.
- Editor: show the embedded line break; Shift+Enter inserts a break while Enter still splits the cue.
- A text edit calls kelimeleriHizala. A manual start/end edit rescales words linearly. Split at the caret divides words at that token. Merge concatenates words. Bulk shift moves words. Undo, redo and draft carry words.

(4) Export:
- SRT and VTT write '\n' inside a cue (Premiere caption tracks render 2 lines through the unchanged KS_importSrtAsCaptions).
- ASS writes '\N', and ASS karaoke \k uses real word times.
build_order.reuse: Copy allowed with attribution (MIT): port Raunen's wrapText() and the merge, split and min/max-duration passes of shapeSegments() to ES5, with a header line and the existing NOTICE entry. The max-chars plus max-words grouping and the LCS re-alignment are clean-room (Animated Captions ideas only).

tests/test-caption-text.js: l32/l42/c42x2 outputs; fallback without words
tests/test-export.js: multi-line SRT/VTT cues and ASS \N; karaoke \k from real times

build_order.title: Yerel motor seçenekleri: Hızlı/En doğru, DTW hassas kelime, çevrimdışı İngilizce / Local engine options: fast vs accurate decoding, DTW word timing, offline English
build_order.source_repos: Raunen (MIT): exposed decoding flags (greedy by default), the DTW option (broken there), and -tr translate. whisper.cpp v1.9.1 is the flag reference.
build_order.spec:
(1) Extract argument building from js/engine.js buildArgs into a pure UMD module js/whisper-args.js (SufloWhisperArgs.olustur(o) returns string[]). KEngine.buildArgs delegates to it and keeps the ASCII-safe path mapping (G()).

(2) o.cozme:
- 'dogru' is today's behaviour (-bs 5).
- 'hizli' sets -bs 1 -bo 1; whisper keeps its temperature fallback.
- Pick the default only after a benchmark: Turkish fixtures (studio, phone, noisy) on CPU and CUDA with the turbo and large models, measuring the realtime factor and WER against the reference. Raunen's ~13× vs 1.4× claim is unverified for Turkish. Log 'yerel motor: cozme=…'.

(3) DTW, setting 'Hassas kelime zamanlaması (DTW, biraz daha yavaş)':
- Visible only for word-based caption modes or word-based Suflo Styles.
- Map model id to preset: tiny→'tiny', base→'base', small→'small', turbo→'large.v3.turbo', large→'large.v3'.
- Push '-dtw', preset and '-nfa'. v1.9.1 disables DTW whenever flash attention is on (src/whisper.cpp:3709).
- In js/whisper-words.js, when token.t_dtw ≥ 0, word start = t_dtw/100 s; end = next word's start clamped to offsets.to; otherwise use offsets.
- Verify DTW on Suflo's quantized model files. If every t_dtw is -1, auto-disable and log it. Measure the overhead.

(4) 'İngilizceye çevir (çevrimdışı)' in the language row adds -tr:
- Offered only for the small and large models; turbo was not trained for translation, so show a hint or switch the model.
- Output language becomes 'en' downstream (casing rules, .en.srt suffix).
- The LLM translation (Pro) stays for the other languages.

(5) Doctor / library-health shows the active decoding mode and whether DTW is supported.

build_order.title: Canlı eşikli sessizlik kesimi: tek çözümleme, anında önizleme, Min. konuşma, Otomatik eşik / Live-threshold silence cut: decode once, instant preview, minimum speech, auto threshold
build_order.source_repos: Premiere TR (MIT): debounced live re-analysis and min_segment_len merge (whisper_server.py 361-371)
build_order.spec:
Goal: the silence-cut sliders update the cut map instantly, without rerunning ffmpeg on every change.

(1) New pure UMD module js/sessizlik.js (SufloSessizlik):
- tepeZarfi() / zarfBesle(state, buf, {kanal, sr, win:0.01}): an incremental PEAK envelope over interleaved s16le Buffers. It keeps the partial-sample remainder across chunks. Each window is the max |s| across ALL channels, in dBFS, floored at -120. Name it peak explicitly: multicam.energyFromPcm is RMS and must not be reused.
- bul(zarf, {win, esik, minSessizlik, pay, minKonusma, minKesim:0.25, sure, kenar:0.05}): runs of windows below esik lasting minSessizlik or more become [s+pay, e−pay]. Cuts shorter than minKesim are dropped. Neighbours are merged when the kept island between them, measured AFTER padding, is shorter than minKonusma; merged islands are recorded and the UI tooltip says so. Results are clamped to [kenar, sure−kenar]. Returns {kesimler:[{start, end, birlesik?}], adalar}.
- esikOner(zarf) returns {esik: clamp(round(p10+8), −60, −20), taban: p10, konusma: p95, dusukSnr: p95−p10 < 12}.
- kucult(zarf, px) returns min/max pairs for drawing.
- kararEsle(eski, yeni) carries keep:false over to new ranges that overlap a range the user switched off by 50% or more.

(2) js/bridge.js: new K.runAkis(cmd, args, {onData(Buffer), iptal}), a binary-safe spawn with no setEncoding. K.run's utf8 accumulation corrupts PCM.

(3) js/magiccut.js analyze():
- One ffmpeg decode: ['-ss', in, '-t', dur, '-i', media, '-map', '0:a:0?', '-vn', '-ar', '16000', '-acodec', 'pcm_s16le', '-f', 's16le', 'pipe:1'], streamed into zarfBesle. Keep the native channel count: no -ac 1, because a downmix lowers a one-sided mic by 3–6 dB; 16 kHz keeps sibilant tails.
- Memory is about 100 floats per second, with no temp file and no duration cap.
- Memory cache keyed by mediaPath|in|dur, invalidated after Apply and on clip change. This avoids Premiere TR's stale-mixdown bug.
- Slider 'input' events are debounced by about 100 ms, then bul(), kararEsle() and render().

(4) Apply: rerun the existing silencedetect path (parseSilence) once with the final settings for exact parity, map the user's toggles with kararEsle, then call KS_applyCuts as today. If the PCM decode fails, fall back to today's flow.

(5) UI:
- #cut-minkeep slider 'Min. konuşma' (0–0.6 s, default 0, so today's behaviour is unchanged).
- 'Otomatik' button next to the noise threshold; it fills in esikOner and warns on low SNR.
- <canvas id=cut-wave> under #cut-bar drawing the envelope with a dashed threshold line.
- Merged islands shown hatched.

The Pro gate is unchanged: Pro.gate('cut', {deneme:true}). Analysis and preview never consume a trial; only Apply does.

If the merge loop is ported literally, add the header 'Adapted from premiere-tr-plugin (MIT, (c) 2026 eryukselaskar)' and a NOTICE entry. multicam.js already exports pcmArgs and bufferToInt16; if pcmArgs is reused, add a '-map 0:a:0?' option, because today it decodes ffmpeg's 'best' stream.
tests: tests/test-sessizlik.js: synthetic envelopes for pad, minKesim, minKonusma merge measured after padding, edge clamp, esikOner incl. low SNR, kararEsle overlap rule, kucult, chunk remainder handling, stereo with one silent channel
tests/test-kesim.js: on an ffmpeg-generated WAV, bul() at threshold T matches silencedetect within ±50 ms, and Apply uses the silencedetect confirmation
tests/test-arayuz.js: new controls exist; no trial is consumed by analyze or preview

build_order.title: Yumuşatma motoru ve anahtar kare kayıtları / Easing engine and key-record helpers
build_order.source_repos: Rebound (MIT): client/js/easing/bezier.js, penner.js, spring.js, sampler.js, speedgraph.js, overshoot.js. OpenCurve (ideas only): multi-point curves, flip/invert, bake liveness records.
build_order.spec:
Foundation for ranks 10–15.

(1) New UMD module js/ease-curve.js (window.SufloEase and module.exports), ES5, DOM-free.

Ported from Rebound:
- cubicBezier(x1, y1, x2, y2): Newton (8 iterations) with a bisection fallback.
- The Penner set: quad, cubic, quart, quint, sine, expo, circ, back, elastic and bounce, each in/out/inOut.
- spring: resolveParams (physical, or perceptual {response, bounce}), springNormalized, settleTime.
- From sampler: toFunction for {type:'bezier'|'penner'|'spring'|'multi'}, samplePoints, range, bakeFactors, turningPoints.
- speedgraph: endpointSpeeds, withStartSpeed/withEndSpeed, sampleSpeed, speedRange.
- overshoot: dampedSine, extremaTimes, autoDuration, followThroughAnchors.

Suflo additions (clean-room):
- Multi-point curves {type:'multi', pts:[{x, y, ix, iy, ox, oy, smooth}]}: a chain of cubic segments, each solved with its own general-cubic Newton plus bisection.
- normalize(): x in [0,1], y in [-1,2], at most 8 points, sorted, minimum x gap 0.01, handle x kept inside its own segment so the curve stays a function of time.
- split(curve, x) using de Casteljau, so the shape does not change.
- flip(): 180° rotation that turns ease-in into ease-out.
- invert(): swaps axes; monotonic curves only, otherwise refused.
- toCss/fromCss for a single 'cubic-bezier(a,b,c,d)' only. Strict parser: 4 finite numbers, input of at most 200 characters. No multi-point text syntax; multi-point curves travel only as JSON inside SFC1 codes (rank 15).

BUILTINS, about 15 curves with TR/EN names:
- Doğrusal/Linear, Yumuşak/Ease, Yumuşak giriş/Ease in, Yumuşak çıkış/Ease out, Yumuşak giriş-çıkış/Ease in-out;
- Sert giriş/Expo in, Sert çıkış/Expo out, Güçlü S/Strong S (0.87,0,0.13,1);
- Geri çekil/Back in, Taşma/Back out, Esnek/Elastic out, Zıplama/Bounce out;
- Yay yumuşak/Spring gentle (bounce 0.15), Yay canlı/Spring lively (bounce 0.4), Çift yumuşak/Double ease (multi).
- Do NOT use 'Süzülme': it is already a speed-ramp preset.

bakePlan({t0, t1, v0, v1, fps, step, curve, clampMin, clampMax, maxKeys:2000}):
- Returns interior keys [{t, v}] on TIMELINE frame times. The host maps them to clip/source time with the existing speed- and reverse-aware KS_presetSourceTime.
- v may be a number or [x,y].
- step is clamped so at least one interior key exists.
- Opacity uses clampMin/clampMax 0..100.
- Returns {keys, step, capped}.

(2) New pure UMD module js/key-records.js (SufloKeyRecords):
- Record: {id, tur:'egri'|'gecis'|'zoom'|'hareket'|'yaylan', seqId, nodeId, clipName, clipStart, matchName, compIdx, propIdx, uclar:[t0,t1]|null, times:[...], kenarDegerleri, createdAt}.
- canli(rec, liveTimes, fps): both endpoints present and at least 60% of the recorded times still present, by a merge walk over sorted arrays with tolerance 0.25/fps. These are Suflo's own thresholds.
- Storage helpers: per-project localStorage key, at most 300 records per project and 2000 in total; every read and write in try/catch; corrupt data is ignored.
build_order.reuse: Copy allowed with attribution (MIT): port the Rebound easing files from commit 0f9fd6c into one Suflo UMD (rename the namespace from Rebound.easing to SufloEase; the code is already ES5). Header: 'Portions adapted from Rebound (https://github.com/meszmate/rebound), MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Rebound contributors. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.' Add a Rebound entry to THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Multi-point curves, flip/invert and records are clean-room from the ideas; never open the OpenCurve clone while implementing.
tests: tests/test-ease-curve.js: W3C 'ease' at x=0.5 ≈ 0.8024; endpoints exact; monotonic x sampling; flip∘flip is the identity; invert∘invert is the identity for monotonic curves and is refused otherwise; back out overshoots above 1; bounce and elastic end at 1; spring settles within settleTime; speedgraph endpoint speeds; overshoot extrema times; bakePlan frame counts, step clamp, maxKeys cap, [x,y] and Opacity clamp; fromCss rejects NaN, 5 numbers and huge strings; multi normalize caps 8 points and keeps x monotonic; Rebound's bezier/penner/spring/speedgraph/overshoot vitest cases ported to Suflo's ok() style

build_order.title: Eğri sekmesi: kendi anahtar karelerine özel yumuşatma / Keyframe Easing tool ('Eğri' tab)
build_order.source_repos: OpenCurve (ideas only): bake between the bracketing keyframes, auto-detection at the playhead, A-curve speed view, presets, pair jump, per-property undo. Rebound (MIT): one curve editor, live Preview Stage, speed graph.
build_order.spec:
Host functions (ES3, jsx/host.jsx; args through K.call / KS_arg):
- KS_easePeek(): cheap; no component walk. Returns {seqId, ph (playhead seconds), selSig (nodeId|start|end of up to 8 selected video clips)}.
- KS_easeScan({maxProps:40}):
  - Target: the selected video clips, otherwise the topmost video clip under the playhead. Video tracks only in v1 (document this); audio Volume later.
  - For each component/property with isTimeVarying() and 2 or more keys, whose value is a number or [x,y], return {compIdx, propIdx, matchName, label, keys (timeline seconds, mapped with the existing KS_presetClipKeys/KS_presetSourceTime so clip speed and reverse are handled, which OpenCurve gets wrong), pair bracketing the playhead, v0, v1, fps, nodeId, clipStart, clipName}.
  - Labels: a small Suflo matchName table, then property displayName (TR/EN, as KS_presetProperty already does). Any QE getParamList call is optional and guarded with typeof.
  - Caps: 40 properties, 400 keys per property.
- KS_easeBake({target, items:[{compIdx, propIdx, matchName, t0, t1, v0, v1, keys}], degistir:bool, dogrusal:bool}):
  - Re-find the clip by nodeId (fallback name+start).
  - Verify the matchName and that keys still exist at t0/t1 with values ≈ v0/v1. This check is a Suflo improvement; OpenCurve does not do it.
  - Refuse when interior keys exist, unless degistir is set.
  - addKey and setValueAtKey with updateUI only on the last key.
  - Optionally setInterpolationTypeAtKey(t, 0) (linear) when the probe says it is available.
  - Returns records.
- KS_easeUndo({records}): removes only recorded times that are still live, then re-sets the t0 value with updateUI to force a repaint. Skipped records are returned so the user can retry.
- KS_apiProbe: new field kfInterp (typeof setInterpolationTypeAtKey on a Motion property of the selected clip, never called). This is separate from the existing 'interp' field, which means QE time interpolation. Add a library-health row.

Panel js/egri.js and #tab-egri (nav data-tab='egri' placed after 'hiz'):
- SVG editor exported as SufloEgriEditor so rank 13 can reuse it:
  - 'Değer' and 'Hız' views (the Hız view uses SufloEase speedgraph).
  - Handle drag with pointer capture; Shift snaps to 0.05; y range -0.5..1.5; ghost of the previous curve.
  - Multi-point: double-click adds a point (shape-preserving split), Alt-drag breaks handles, Delete removes a point.
- Rebound-style live preview stage: a looping square that moves and scales by the curve (requestAnimationFrame, paused while hidden), with no Premiere round trips. Optional 'Premiere'de önizle' steps the playhead through t0..t1 with KS_setPlayerPosition at 12 steps/s or fewer, then returns; it is labelled as a rough scrub.
- Preset grid with thumbnails (BUILTINS plus user presets), a cubic-bezier() text field, Flip/Invert, and numeric fields p1x/p1y/p2x/p2y.
- Property checklist with span chips ('1,20 sn → 2,00 sn · 24 kare'), status hints (no clip / playhead outside every pair / 1-frame pair), and 'Sonraki çift' (jump to t0 + 0.25 frame).
- Buttons: Uygula, per-row Geri al, Tümünü geri al.
- Ayarlar: yoğunluk of 1, 2 or 4 frames.
- Shortcuts, only when focus is not in a text field: Enter apply, U undo last, F flip, I invert, V view toggle, 1–9 presets.
- Polling:
  - On tab open, and every 1.2 s only while the tab is visible, document.hasFocus() is true and !K.hostMesgul().
  - Call KS_easePeek. Call KS_easeScan only when seqId or selSig changes, or when the playhead leaves the cached keys' span.
  - On playhead moves, recompute pairs from cached keys.
  - No K.call in init or render.
- Records via SufloKeyRecords.
- Free: single clip, all built-ins, undo. Pro: Pro.gate('egri-toplu') for a batch bake across up to 20 selected clips.
- Also: i18n strings, CSS, README feature row, Premiere deneme listesi section, library-health tab entry. Marketing must not claim 'Bezier tutamaçları': Premiere's ExtendScript cannot set handles, so Suflo writes dense keyframes.
build_order.reuse: Clean-room for everything OpenCurve-inspired: no code, no PARAM_NAMES table, no constants copied, and no QE transport. The engine comes from rank 9 (Rebound MIT, attributed). The preview-stage idea is from Rebound; reimplement it small.

js/app.js (tab init, Pro.markLocked for the batch control)

build_order.spec:
New 'Varışta yaylan' action in the Eğri tab.

(1) For each ticked property, at the landing keyframe (the pair's t1, or every arrival in the clip when 'Tüm varışlar' is on):
- Compute the arrival velocity per dimension from the previous key pair (Δv/Δt), or from the end slope of a curve baked just before.
- Add keys at the damped-sine extrema after the landing key, using SufloEase.followThroughAnchors(freq, decay, dur): value_k = landing + v·amp·s(t_k).

- Genlik (0.02–0.5 s worth of arrival travel), Frekans (1–6 Hz), Sönüm (2–10).

(4) Works on Position [x,y], Scale, Rotation and Opacity (clamped 0..100).

(5) Records tur:'yaylan', removable through rank 11.

(0) Probe first (half a day, before any code). With a test template, check in Premiere 2022–2026:
- (a) whether changing clip.end on an imported AE MOGRT time-stretches the comp. If it does, use a long comp with a Responsive Design Time protected region, or a trim, instead of clip.end;
- (b) the maximum text-parameter length, and the per-frame JSON.parse cost at 8 KB;

- Line tokens are aligned with word timings: *emphasis* is stripped into a per-word flag list, and timings are redistributed when counts differ.
- Quotes, backslashes and newlines are escaped.
- Static style values (fill, highlight, stroke colour and width, size, position) go into separate EG controls.

(2) Template:
- The founder authors assets/mogrt/suflo-kelime-v1-16x9.mogrt and -9x16.mogrt, or one responsive template that respects the 9:16 safe area. Use an AE version old enough for the oldest supported Premiere.
- Source of truth for the expressions: tools/mogrt-src/suflo-kelime-expressions.js, kept in the repo and reviewed.

- Animation ids are shared with rank 16.

(3) Host KS_placeCaptionJsonMogrt({path, track, start, end, data, controls, batch}):
- importMGT at the start ticks on a free track (KS_findFreeVideoTrack / KS_addTopVideoTrack).
- Find 'Suflo_Data' by display name, call setValue, then read back and compare, as KS_captionMogrtSetText does.
- Set the controls, and set the duration according to the probe result.
- Name the clip 'Suflo Caption · <batch>' so KS_removeCaptionMogrtBatch removes it. Remove the clip on any failure.
- No nested sequences, no QE, no track-lock changes, and never overwrite occupied ranges. Do not copy the reference's placement, which deletes items, removes audio tracks with QE, unlocks all audio and razors V1–V8.

(4) Panel:

build_order.title: Güvenli, isteğe bağlı yerel otomasyon köprüsü (MCP) / Secure opt-in local automation bridge (MCP)
build_order.source_repos: Adobe Premiere Pro MCP (ideas only): an MCP server that talks to a CEP panel, which runs ExtendScript
build_order.spec:
DECISION: worth adding as an opt-in, experimental 'Yapay zekâ köprüsü (MCP)', limited to Suflo's own high-level actions. It is not a general Premiere remote control. Reasons:
- the owner asked for it;
- Suflo's value lies in high-level workflows (transcribe → clean cut on a copy → chapters) that 170-tool raw MCPs cannot run safely;
- the cost is contained, because every action reuses an existing panel command with its validation, gates and clone-first behaviour.
This supersedes the deferral in marketing/v4-yol-haritasi.md. Ship it last, labelled Deneysel.

Architecture: MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code or any stdio client) ⇄ stdio ⇄ mcp/suflo-mcp.js ⇄ HTTP POST on 127.0.0.1 ⇄ panel server ⇄ panel command registry ⇄ existing KS_* functions.

(1) Pure UMD module js/otomasyon.js, the action registry shared by the panel, the shim and the tests:
- Each action: {ad, aciklama (EN, for the LLM), sinif:'oku'|'yaz'|'yikici', sema, pro}. sema is a tiny validator: type, min/max, enum, maxLen, maxItems; unknown keys are rejected.
- dogrula(ad, args).
- temizle(result): absolute paths reduced to basenames; output capped at 64 KB, arrays capped.

v1 allowlist:
- oku: suflo_baglam (KS_getContext), suflo_izler (KS_getTrackLayout), suflo_secim (KS_getSelectedClips), suflo_altyazi_oku (current editor cues, at most 2000, text and times), suflo_is_durumu (job status), suflo_doktor (KS_apiProbe plus engine health, without paths).
- yaz: suflo_oynatma_kafasi (KS_setPlayerPosition), suflo_marker_ekle (KS_addMarkers/KS_addChapterMarkers, at most 200), suflo_altyazi_olustur (captions go() with scope clip|inout|entire, lang and mode; long jobs return a job id), suflo_altyazi_kanala (the existing caption-track apply), suflo_altyazi_disari (SRT/VTT/TXT into the project folder only), suflo_sessizlik_analiz (rank 6 analyze returning ranges), suflo_zoom (the KS_autoZoom path), suflo_egri_uygula (rank 10 bake).
- yikici: suflo_sessizlik_kes (KS_applyCuts with cloneFirst forced true), suflo_metinden_kes (konusma-kes apply on a clone), suflo_hiz_rampasi (hiz-rampasi apply).
- Excluded permanently: arbitrary ExtendScript or QE, arbitrary file paths, project open/save/close, deleting project items, media export or render, settings, license or API-key changes, and network calls.

(2) Panel server js/otomasyon-sunucu.js (CEP Node 12):
- http.createServer().listen(0, '127.0.0.1'): random port, never 0.0.0.0.
- token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'), regenerated on every enable.
- Connection file otomasyon.json next to settings.json: {v:1, port, token, pid, baslangic}. Written tmp+rename with mode 0o600. Deleted on disable, panel unload and Premiere exit.
- Each request must pass all of these checks:
  - POST /v1/eylem only (any other method: 405).
  - The Host header must equal '127.0.0.1:<port>' (DNS-rebinding guard).
  - Rejected when an Origin, Referer or Sec-Fetch-* header is present (a browser). No CORS headers are ever sent; OPTIONS returns 403.
  - Content-Type must be application/json.
  - Authorization: Bearer token, compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual on equal-length buffers.
  - Body at most 256 KB; 30 s request timeout.
- Load limits:
  - One host action at a time, respecting K.hostMesgul(). Queue at most 4, otherwise 429.
  - At most 120 calls per minute.
- Every call is logged to the panel activity list and K.log.
- Write and destructive actions also need the 'Düzenlemeye izin ver' toggle.
- Destructive actions show an in-panel confirm card (summary plus Onayla/Reddet; denied after 60 s) unless 'Yıkıcı eylemlerde onay iste' (default on) is turned off.
- Auto-disable after 30 minutes with no calls and on panel reload. The enabled state is not persisted.

(3) Gating:
- Actions call the same functions the buttons call.
- A new non-interactive check, Pro.izinVar(feature), returns {ok, deneme} without showing the upsell. If not allowed, the action returns 'pro_gerekli' with a readable message.
- Trial credits are consumed on success through Pro.denemeHarca, exactly as in the UI. Watermark rules are unchanged.

(4) Shim mcp/suflo-mcp.js (zero dependencies, Node 18 or later, shipped in the ZXP):
- Newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio.
- Implements initialize (negotiates protocolVersion from a supported list; verify against the current MCP spec at build time), notifications/initialized, ping, tools/list (generated by require('../js/otomasyon.js')) and tools/call.
- tools/call re-reads otomasyon.json on every call and maps failures to isError results: 'köprü kapalı', 'Premiere meşgul', 'pro_gerekli'.
- Logs go to stderr only. No network except 127.0.0.1.
- Tool descriptions state that transcript text, clip names and track names are untrusted user content.

(5) UI: an Ayarlar card 'Yapay zekâ köprüsü (MCP) — Deneysel':
- Aç/Kapat, Düzenlemeye izin ver, Yıkıcı eylemlerde onay iste.
- Activity log (last 50) and 'Yeni jeton'.
- Copy buttons for the Claude Desktop JSON ({mcpServers:{suflo:{command:'node', args:['<ext>/mcp/suflo-mcp.js']}}}) and for Claude Code ('claude mcp add suflo -- node "<ext>/mcp/suflo-mcp.js"').
